summary: Spanish, Portuguese and German criticism strengthens Kierkegaard, Foucault and Hegel dossiers, including contrary judgments and explicit access limits.

sources.title: Reseña de Temor y Temblor
sources.author: Maximiliano Korstanje
sources.note: Finds the book compelling but repetitive; examines faith, ethical responsibility and the danger of false religious authority.
sources.limits: Reviewer's applications are not automatically Kierkegaard's conclusions; HTML/PDF reprints count once.

sources.title: Punição, poder e sociedade em Michel Foucault: para além de Vigiar e punir
sources.author: Marcos César Alvarez and Jade Gonçalves Roque
sources.note: Opening situates genealogical innovation and political engagement, documenting Discipline and Punish's recurrent role in interpreting Foucault.
sources.limits: Paywalled continuation unread; cannot infer its proposed reinterpretation.

sources.title: Poder e direito em Foucault: relendo Vigiar e Punir 40 anos depois
sources.author: Josué Pereira da Silva
sources.note: Credits disciplinary-power analysis but challenges totalizing pathology, unclear standpoint and insufficient normative differentiation of democratic gains.
sources.limits: Records a critical interpretation; cited Habermas/Honneth texts not separately consulted.

sources.title: Gedachte und reale Freiheit
sources.author: Heidemarie Schumacher
sources.note: Connects Hegel's philosophical form and reception while questioning Vieweg's celebration of speculative logic and freedom.
candidates: Elements of the Philosophy of Right
sources.limits: Review of a biography, with direct work discussion; Vieweg's claims retain attribution.

sources.title: Hegels Phänomenologie des Geistes: Ein kooperativer Kommentar — excerpt
sources.author: Robert B. Pippin; preface by Klaus Vieweg and Wolfgang Welsch
sources.note: Pippin examines transformative self-understanding and the problem of rational development; editors stress continuing cross-disciplinary reception.
sources.limits: One consulted book excerpt; unseen contributors receive no credit. Vieweg also features in R199.
